title: Fix change point detection for uncertain non-stationary distributions.

timeline.body: Hi @jan-elastic, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
For change points of e.g. type non-stationary, the location (`cp`) equals `-1` (there's no location). In that case splitting it for the KS test makes no sense and breaks.

reply.body: BTW. Would it make sense to define this as a static constant. It feels slightly cleaner since we use the magic number elsewhere and would make the code a bit easier to read, i.e. something like `NO_CHANGE_POINT = -1`.
How do you feel about using `null` for no change point?
Never mind, I went with your suggestion. Replacing it with `null` requires more code changes and testing.

timeline.body: Hi @jan-elastic, I've updated the changelog YAML for you.
